SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.isSta.type:
@SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.isStable_of_finite_limits_colimits : ∀ {X : SSet} [inst : X.Quasicategory]
  [SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.HasZeroVertex X] [SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.HasFiniteLimits X]
  [SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.HasFiniteColimits X],
  (∀
      (F :
        CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (SSet.stdSimplex.obj { len := 1 })
            (SSet.stdSimplex.obj { len := 1 }) ⟶
          X),
      SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsPullbackSquare F ↔ SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsPushoutSquare F) →
    SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsStable X

SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsSta.type:
@SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsStable.pullback_iff_pushout_square : ∀ {X : SSet} [inst : X.Quasicategory]
  [SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsStable X]
  (R :
    CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (SSet.stdSimplex.obj { len := 1 })
        (SSet.stdSimplex.obj { len := 1 }) ⟶
      X),
  SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsPullbackSquare R ↔ SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsPushoutSquare R

SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Co.type:
@SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Compact.indYoneda_isKappaCompact : ∀ {C : SSet} [inst : C.Quasicategory]
  (κ : Cardinal.{u_1}) (y : C.obj (Opposite.op { len := 0 })),
  SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Compact.IsKappaCompact κ
    ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom
        ((SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Ind.indYoneda κ C).app (Opposite.op { len := 0 })))
      { down := y })

SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.In.type:
SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Ind.ind_isKappaCompact_iff_yoneda : ∀ (κ : Cardinal.{u_1}) [Fact κ.IsRegular]
  {C : SSet} [inst : C.Quasicategory],
  SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Idempotent.IsIdempotentComplete C →
    ∀ (x : (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Ind.IndInfinity κ C).obj (Opposite.op { len := 0 })),
      SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Compact.IsKappaCompact κ x ↔
        ∃ y,
          Nonempty
            (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.VertexIso
              ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom
                  ((SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Ind.indYoneda κ C).app (Opposite.op { len := 0 })))
                { down := y })
              x)

SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Ind.ind_isStable_of_isStable : ∀ (κ : Cardinal.{u_1}) [Fact κ.IsRegular],

    SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Ind.IndFiniteLimitExchangeInput →
      ∀ (C : SSet) [inst : C.Quasicategory] [SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsStable C],
        SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsStable (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.F2.Ind.IndInfinity κ C)

SerrePositivity.KST.SConstruction.isGapp.type:
@SerrePositivity.KST.SConstruction.isGapped_iff_triples : ∀ {n : ℕ} {C : SSet} [C.Quasicategory]
  (F : SerrePositivity.KST.SConstruction.arNerve n ⟶ C),
  SerrePositivity.KST.SConstruction.IsGapped F ↔
    (∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)),
        SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsZeroVertex
          ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (F.app (Opposite.op { len := 0 })))
            (CategoryTheory.ComposableArrows.mk₀ (SerrePositivity.KST.SConstruction.arObj i i ⋯)))) ∧
      ∀ (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k),
        SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsPushoutSquare
          (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (SerrePositivity.KST.SConstruction.arSquare i j j k hij ⋯ hjk) F)
